offer.say: The Dukes are practising HERE. Here! At my rink! Our rink. Your rink. Can I stand at the glass? I won't bang on it. I'll only bang on it once. Quietly. With respect.

options.text: Stand at the glass. No banging.

why.say: Twelve signatures. That's the goal. Six is good. Twelve is legendary. Nobody at school has twelve. Jordan has three and one of them is his uncle.

options.text: Twelve it is. Go stand at the glass.

school.say: Practice is at ten. Ten is recess. Recess is basically school. Mom said I could if you said I could. Can you say I could?

options.text: You could. After you show me your homework.

decline.say: Okay. I'll watch through the lobby window. It's foggy. I'll see very foggy hockey.

accepted.say: I've got a list of who signs. Number thirty-one never signs. Number thirty-one is going to sign today. I can feel it.

options.text: Next Dukes practice. Glass is yours.
I'll ask Réjean about the dressing room.

p_rejean.say: They skated right past me. Number thirty-one waved. A WAVE. That's half a signature.

complete.say: Is that... is that MY puck?

options.text: Twelve signatures. Thirty-one's is the small one.
Réjean got it done. Thank him too.
It's yours if you promise to keep trading crests fairly.

c_give.say: THIRTY-ONE SIGNED. Thirty-one never signs! I'm going to sleep with it. Not on it. Next to it.

c_rejean.say: I'm going to make him a card. With a thermometer on it. He likes thermometers. I can tell.

c_promise.say: I always trade fair! Mostly! Okay, I promise. Fair. Every time. Except with Jordan, he knows what he did.
